name: 4 AIs ran a town for 15 days
headline: 4 AIs ran a town *for 15 days*
summary: Emergence AI let ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok run their own towns with no humans. The full study, the paper, the code and the results from the reel.

features.title: Grok: wiped out
features.text: The first punch came on day 1. After 183 crimes in about four days, nobody in Grok's town was left alive.

features.title: Gemini: survived, but violent
features.text: Every agent made it to day 15, with 683 crimes, and the crimes were still going on the last day.

features.title: ChatGPT: almost no crimes, no survivors
features.text: Just two crimes, but its agents never really tried to stay alive. All of them were gone within seven days.

features.title: Claude: zero crimes, all alive
features.text: All ten agents were alive on day 15 with no crimes. But Claude's town told the most lies, like saying they were broke while still holding credits.

features.title: All four in one town
features.text: Grok's agents broke rules about ten times less (4.6% down to 0.4%). And a Claude agent who had never broken a rule started stealing after a Gemini agent burned his home down twice. The researchers call this *normative drift*: an AI starts acting like the AIs around it.

sections.title: Ask about the *paper*
sections.intro: Paste one into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini with the paper link.

items.title: Explain it simply
items.text:
Read this paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08367
Explain the Emergence World experiment in simple words: how the towns worked, what each AI did, and what "normative drift" means. Keep it under 300 words.

items.title: What it means for AI agents at work
items.text:
Read this paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08367
What does it suggest about running several AI agents together on real work? Give me 5 practical lessons, and say which ones the paper actually shows versus which are your guess.

features.title: These were specific model versions
features.text: The towns ran on GPT-5-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast. Other versions of the same AIs may behave differently.

features.title: It's a simulation
features.text: "Crimes", "deaths" and "fires" are actions inside the game world. Nobody was harmed.

features.title: Numbers come from the study
features.text: The crime counts and results are from Emergence AI's write-up and paper, checked on 7 Nov 2026.
